biblio.label: U.S. Patent Application Publication No. US 2025/0354568 A1

summary: This document discloses a compressed-air-driven vacuum generation device with a silencer apparatus and multiple modules, including an interface module, control valve module, control piston module, nozzle module, and silencer module.
